title: Slocum 水下滑翔機
summary: 以Slocum滑翔機的剖面觀測為例，將浮力引擎、滑翔幾何、流場與資料回傳連成循環；區分省電移動與感測品質。 各單元為獨立縮尺練習，串接的是驗證流程，不是同一實船的校準數位分身。
summaryEn: Use Slocum profile observations to connect buoyancy engine, glide geometry, current and data return in a cycle, separating low-energy motion from measurement quality. Units are independent scaled exercises connected by a verification workflow, not a calibrated digital twin of one vessel.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的原創船舶海洋教學。數值均為明示假設，不是同名船舶的實測規格、法規認證或實船操作參數。以虛構資料、教學模型與常壓桌面練習學習，排除武器、戰術與載人下潛操作。
scopeEn: Original marine teaching based on public principles. All numbers are explicit assumptions, not measured named-vessel specifications, certification criteria or real-ship operating parameters. Learning uses synthetic data, teaching models and unpressurized desktop exercises, excluding weapons, tactics and crewed diving operations.

steps.title: 比較增體積與減質量的浮力效果：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Compare increasing volume with reducing mass: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 比較增體積與減質量的浮力效果 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Compare increasing volume with reducing mass and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 比較增體積與減質量的浮力效果：阿基米德浮力取決於排開流體的重量；載具質量與外部排水體積必須使用同一系統邊界。 本步以「排水體積與浮力」對應案例介面，先標記輸入、輸出與未計入項目。
steps.instructionEn: Compare increasing volume with reducing mass: Archimedean buoyancy is the weight of displaced fluid; vehicle mass and external displaced volume must share a system boundary. Use Displaced volume and buoyancy to describe the case interface, marking input, output and omitted terms first.
steps.observation: 各單元數值是獨立練習，不能合併成同一實船的質量或能源帳。本單元獨立的原創縮尺教學資料，不是Slocum 水下滑翔機實際規格：海水密度1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²、排水體積V=0.0864 m³。式 F=ρgV，基準結果 868.7736 N。條件：均勻、靜止流體；不含波浪、纜線垂直力與可壓縮性。
steps.observationEn: Numbers in different units are independent exercises and cannot be combined into one vessel mass or energy ledger. Independent original scaled data for this unit, not actual specifications of Slocum underwater glider: Seawater density 1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², displaced volume V=0.0864 m³. Formula F=ρgV gives 868.7736 N. Conditions: Uniform static fluid; waves, vertical tether forces and compressibility are excluded.
steps.failure: 配重更換後仍沿用舊總質量會錯判淨浮力；先核對零件質量帳，再討論密度誤差。 若案例資料尚缺，先標為未驗證，不能用同名船舶的外觀照片填補數值。
steps.failureEn: Reusing the old total mass after changing ballast misidentifies net buoyancy; check the mass ledger before attributing errors to density. Mark missing case data as unverified rather than filling values from a photograph of the named vessel.
steps.check: 在常壓透明水槽以塑膠浮體量取排水量，分開記錄乾重及附掛配重；比對浮起方向與模型。 本案例另須檢查「比較增體積與減質量的浮力效果」與前一步資料是否使用同一時間、單位與系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Use a plastic float in an unpressurized transparent tank to measure displacement; log dry mass and attached ballast separately and compare motion with the model. Also check that Compare increasing volume with reducing mass and the preceding step share time, units and system boundaries.

knowledge.text: 本單元任務：比較增體積與減質量的浮力效果。在滑翔剖面圖、浮力引擎能量卡、CTD假資料完成資料或紙面模型練習。只把排水體積增加10%，核對浮力是否增加10%。 算式區的基準值為868.7736，改變後為955.65096 N。先預測方向，再計算、記錄原式與新式，最後寫下仍需量測的資料。

Increase only displaced volume by 10% and check a 10% increase in buoyancy. Baseline 868.7736 changes to 955.65096 N. Predict direction, calculate, retain both expressions and record the measurement still needed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Slocum 水下滑翔機」的「比較增體積與減質量的浮力效果：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出船模、排水體積、能源、感測與觀測資料的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配重表、排水量、聲速或時間戳、原始量測與模型尺度的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Compare increasing volume with reducing mass: Mechanism and observation” in “Slocum underwater glider”. Draw the model vessel, displaced volume, energy, sensors and observation-data boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ballast manifest, displacement, sound speed/timestamps, raw data and model scale, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.
